rows.evaluation_data: Submit the following for FAA review: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating Dermatologist or Rheumatologist no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam. It must include: - A detailed summary of the history of the condition; - Current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any); - Physical exam findings; - Results of any testing performed; - Diagnosis; - Assessment and plan; - Prognosis; and - Follow-up. The Clinical Progress Note must specifically include: - If any co-morbid conditions are present - Documentation of counseling on guideline-directed screening for co-morbid conditions See Pilot Information – Clinical Progress Note .

caci_worksheets.title: CACI – Psoriasis Worksheet

criteria.ame_must_review: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note from the treating physician
criteria.acceptable_certification_criteria: [ ] Condition is stable with NO systemic symptoms and NO limitation to strength, function, or range of motion which would interfere with flight duties. [ ] Severity is mild to moderate. NOTE: If co-morbid conditions are present, see corresponding page. If psoriatic arthritis, see arthritis page.
[ ] Most subtypes to include: guttate psoriasis, plaque psoriasis. Not acceptable: pustular psoriasis, erythrodermic psoriasis.

criteria.ame_must_review: Medications for condition Combinations acceptable for CACI Include: - Topical medication + - Methotrexate + - Any single agent listed KEY: Interleukin Inhibitors (IL) Phosphodiesterase-4 Enzyme Inhibitor (PDE4) Tumor necrosis factor inhibitors (TNF) *Biologics do not have generic; they have biosimilar.
criteria.acceptable_certification_criteria: [ ] Topical medication(s) and/or [ ] azathioprine (Imuran) and/or [ ] methotrexate (Trexall) and/or [ ] Any single medication listed below after a 2-week ground trial and: - - No post-dose observation time: - o apremilast (Otezla) - PD4E - 4-hour post-dose observation time: - o adalimumab (Humira or FDA approved biosimilar*) - TNF - o certolizumab (Cimzia) - TNF - o etanercept (Enbrel) - TNF - o guselkumab (Tremfya) - IL - o ixekizumab (Taltz) - IL - o risankizumab (Skyrizi) - IL - o secukinumab (Cosentyx) – IL - o tildrakizumab (Ilumya) - IL - o ustekinumab (Stelara) - IL - 24-hour post-dose observation time: - o infliximab (Inflect; Remicade; Renflexis) - TNF
